meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 7 阶段流程,从你的工作负载描述出发规划 Azure 企业基础架构(网络、身份、安全、合规等),产出计划,生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码,并在部署前做本地校验和安全扫描。
howto.when: 当你说“规划 Azure 基础设施”“设计中心辐射型网络”“规划多云区域容灾拓扑”等,或要求基于工作负载描述生成订阅级 Bicep/Terraform 部署时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 Azure 登陆区,含中心辐射网络、防火墙和私有端点。
say.note: Claude 会先出基础设施计划,经你批准后才生成代码。

say.text: 基于这个多区域容灾需求,生成 Terraform 代码。
say.note: 会进入生成阶段,并在本地校验和安全检查后才部署。

say.text: 我们已有现有订阅资源,请按增量方式规划新工作负载并部署。
say.note: 会盘点现有资源,只做增量部署,不修改或销毁它们。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude plans Azure enterprise infrastructure from a workload description via an approval-gated 7-phase pipeline: plans, generates Bicep/Terraform, validates locally, runs checkov, deploys.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to plan Azure infrastructure, a landing zone, hub-spoke network, multi-region DR, or subscription-scope Bicep/Terraform deployment from a workload description.

say_en.text: Help me plan an Azure landing zone with hub-spoke network, firewalls, and private endpoints.
Generate Terraform for this multi-region DR topology from the requirements.
We have existing subscription resources; plan the new workload incrementally and deploy.
